name: meetflow
description: MeetFlow — plataforma profesional de gestión de reuniones

scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @meetflow/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @meetflow/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @meetflow/api exec prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @meetflow/api exec prisma db seed
